biases.name: Attentional Bias
biases.desc: Recurring thoughts direct attention to emotionally dominant stimuli
biases.cathedral: Agents over-attend to domains with recent activity

biases.name: Inattentional Blindness
biases.desc: Failure to notice unexpected stimulus in plain sight
biases.cathedral: Vault orphans — 191 principles nobody sees

biases.name: Change Blindness
biases.desc: Failure to detect changes in visual scene
biases.cathedral: Slow drift in agent behavior goes unnoticed

biases.name: Cocktail Party Effect
biases.desc: Selective attention to personally relevant stimuli
biases.cathedral: Taste map anchors create tunnel vision

biases.name: Frequency Illusion (Baader-Meinhof)
biases.desc: Recently learned concept seems to appear everywhere
biases.cathedral: New vault topics get over-detected in subsequent sessions

biases.name: Salience Bias
biases.desc: Prominent features receive disproportionate weight
biases.cathedral: Loud agents (Muse) get more attention than quiet ones (Groundskeeper)

biases.name: Selective Perception
biases.desc: Expectations shape what is perceived
biases.cathedral: Searching vault for confirmation of existing theory

biases.name: Attention Tunneling
biases.desc: Narrow focus causes peripheral blindness
biases.cathedral: Deep research sessions miss cross-domain signals

biases.name: Anchoring
biases.desc: First piece of information dominates subsequent judgments
biases.cathedral: First agent response anchors roundtable consensus

biases.name: Framing Effect
biases.desc: Decision changes based on how information is presented
biases.cathedral: Same finding framed as discovery vs warning gets different treatment

biases.name: Availability Heuristic
biases.desc: Easily recalled events seem more probable
biases.cathedral: Recent session harvests dominate morning briefing

biases.name: Representativeness Heuristic
biases.desc: Judging probability by similarity to prototype
biases.cathedral: Classifying new techniques by surface similarity to known ones

biases.name: Primacy Effect
biases.desc: First items in sequence weighted more heavily
biases.cathedral: First strategy in trading roundtable sets the frame

biases.name: Recency Effect
biases.desc: Most recent information weighted more heavily
biases.cathedral: Latest session harvest overweights older but richer findings

biases.name: Halo Effect
biases.desc: One positive trait colors perception of everything else
biases.cathedral: High-scoring strategy gets benefit of doubt on bad trades

biases.name: Stereotyping
biases.desc: Categorization replaces individual assessment
biases.cathedral: Domain labels prevent cross-domain discovery

biases.name: Contrast Effect
biases.desc: Judgment distorted by comparison to adjacent stimulus
biases.cathedral: Mediocre finding looks great after a run of noise

biases.name: Clustering Illusion
biases.desc: Seeing patterns in random sequences
biases.cathedral: Trading strategies finding signal in random price movements

biases.name: Illusion of Validity
biases.desc: Confidence in judgment exceeds accuracy
biases.cathedral: High-convergence roundtable score doesnt mean the call is right

biases.name: Conjunction Fallacy
biases.desc: Specific conditions judged more probable than general ones
biases.cathedral: Complex multi-strategy confluence feels more reliable than it is

biases.name: Hindsight Bias
biases.desc: Past events seem predictable after the fact
biases.cathedral: Meta-watcher counterfactuals look obvious in retrospect

biases.name: Recall Bias
biases.desc: Certain memories are more accessible, distorting recall
biases.cathedral: Vault search returns recent over historical nuggets

biases.name: Mood-Congruent Memory
biases.desc: Current mood biases which memories surface
biases.cathedral: Cath-state affects what vault context is retrieved

biases.name: Source Confusion
biases.desc: Misattributing the origin of a memory
biases.cathedral: Agent attributing insight to wrong vault note or wrong session

biases.name: Misinformation Effect
biases.desc: Post-event information alters memory of original event
biases.cathedral: Session harvests rewrite what actually happened in conversation

biases.name: Cryptomnesia
biases.desc: Failing to recognize a memory as a memory — thinking its new
biases.cathedral: Muse re-discovering something already in vault as novel

biases.name: Telescoping Effect
biases.desc: Recent events feel further away, distant events feel closer
biases.cathedral: Misjudging when a build was completed or principle was filed

biases.name: Spacing Effect
biases.desc: Spaced repetition aids memory but massed practice feels productive
biases.cathedral: Daily agent pulses vs weekly deep dives — daily feels more productive

biases.name: Confirmation Bias
biases.desc: Seeking/interpreting info that confirms existing beliefs
biases.cathedral: Bandit exploiting known-good domains, ignoring cold ones

biases.name: Anchoring in Update
biases.desc: Insufficient adjustment from initial value
biases.cathedral: Strategy P&L anchors future confidence regardless of new evidence

biases.name: Conservatism Bias
biases.desc: Insufficient updating when new evidence arrives
biases.cathedral: Slow to demote eliminated strategies even with bad data

biases.name: Base Rate Neglect
biases.desc: Ignoring prior probability in favor of specific evidence
biases.cathedral: Individual trade outcome overweights base rate of strategy performance

biases.name: Belief Perseverance
biases.desc: Maintaining belief after evidence is discredited
biases.cathedral: Keeping faith in Cymatics strategy despite weak results

biases.name: Bandwagon Effect
biases.desc: Adopting beliefs because many others hold them
biases.cathedral: Roundtable convergence reinforcing groupthink

biases.name: Reactance
biases.desc: Adopting opposite position when freedom is threatened
biases.cathedral: Contrarian signals in trading — healthy or reactive?

biases.name: Dunning-Kruger Effect
biases.desc: Low competence paired with high confidence
biases.cathedral: New strategies with few trades showing inflated win rates

biases.name: Sunk Cost Fallacy
biases.desc: Continuing because of past investment, not future value
biases.cathedral: Keeping a failing PM2 process running because it was hard to build

biases.name: Status Quo Bias
biases.desc: Preferring current state of affairs
biases.cathedral: Resistance to eliminating underperforming strategies

biases.name: Omission Bias
biases.desc: Preferring inaction over action even when action is better
biases.cathedral: Not wiring vault-dig because existing tools feel sufficient

biases.name: Normalcy Bias
biases.desc: Underestimating probability of unprecedented events
biases.cathedral: Assuming trading experiment will continue in current regime

biases.name: Zero-Risk Bias
biases.desc: Preferring complete elimination of one risk over larger overall reduction
biases.cathedral: Over-engineering one safety net while leaving bigger gaps

biases.name: Endowment Effect
biases.desc: Overvaluing what you already own
biases.cathedral: Overvaluing existing vault content vs new external findings

biases.name: Overconfidence Effect
biases.desc: Confidence intervals too narrow
biases.cathedral: Strategy validator confidence exceeds actual prediction accuracy

biases.name: Planning Fallacy
biases.desc: Underestimating time/cost/risk for future tasks
biases.cathedral: Build estimates always shorter than reality

biases.name: Optimism Bias
biases.desc: Overestimating probability of positive outcomes
biases.cathedral: Paper trading profits assumed to transfer to real money

biases.name: Pessimism Bias
biases.desc: Overestimating probability of negative outcomes
biases.cathedral: WHY.md wound — assuming investment will always lose

biases.name: Curse of Knowledge
biases.desc: Assuming others know what you know
biases.cathedral: Agent system prompts assuming context that isnt loaded

biases.name: Illusory Superiority
biases.desc: Overestimating own abilities relative to others
biases.cathedral: Cathedral assuming it has better architecture than it does

biases.name: Projection Bias
biases.desc: Projecting current preferences onto future self
biases.cathedral: Taste map anchors assumed stable when they evolve

biases.name: Impact Bias
biases.desc: Overestimating emotional impact of future events
biases.cathedral: Imagining Phase 1 real-money trading as scarier than it will be

biases.name: Denomination Effect
biases.desc: Spending patterns change with denomination size
biases.cathedral: DeepSeek at $0.001/call feels free — $20 bill shows its not

biases.name: Decoy Effect
biases.desc: Adding a dominated option changes preference between others
biases.cathedral: Strategy comparisons shift when a weak benchmark is added

biases.name: IKEA Effect
biases.desc: Overvaluing things you built yourself
biases.cathedral: Valuing Cathedral agents more than off-the-shelf tools that might work better

biases.name: Not Invented Here
biases.desc: Rejecting external solutions in favor of internal builds
biases.cathedral: Building instead of using existing open-source when it fits

biases.name: Narrative Fallacy
biases.desc: Creating explanatory stories for random events
biases.cathedral: Trading post-hoc explanations for why a strategy won or lost

biases.name: Survivorship Bias
biases.desc: Drawing conclusions from survivors, ignoring failures
biases.cathedral: Strategy leaderboard shows winners — eliminated strategies forgotten

biases.name: Automation Bias
biases.desc: Over-trusting automated system output
biases.cathedral: Trusting roundtable convergence score as ground truth
